newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl H1 group earnings down 29 pct.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl H1 group earnings down 29 pct.

text.p: Austrian steelmaker VA Stahl said on Friday group earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) fell 29 percent in the first six months to 1.05 billion schillings ($98.6 million) while pre-tax profit fell 31 percent.
Pre-tax profit for the first half reached 1.33 billion schillings against 1.941 billion in the year-ago period.
Net profit fell to 1.03 billion schillings after 1.636 billion in last year's first half and turnover slipped to 15.991 billion schillings against 17.234 billion.
In a statement, the company said further details of the earnings would be made available at its news conference at 0800 GMT. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254 ($ = 10.64 Austrian Schillings)
